title: Learning Dynamic Belief Graphs for Theory-of-mind Reasoning

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if AI could *truly* understand what people are thinking?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech lets AI predict beliefs and intentions in real time.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Dynamic Belief Graphs track how people’s beliefs change as they learn.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses neural networks to model belief updates like a human would.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This helps AI better collaborate, negotiate, and interact with humans.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is letting AI see the world through someone else’s eyes.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how this changes AI’s future? Follow for the breakdown.
